scope: Design requirements and a bounded upgrade queue for the 14 registered portfolio surfaces. These proposed jobs and dated observations do not establish adoption, brand approval or production quality.

checks.requirement: One recipient, one user job and one bounded next action.
acceptance: A first-time user can identify the job, actual availability and consequence before committing.
The primary journey reaches a saved, inspectable or usable outcome with actual content.
evidence: Record task completion, elapsed time, error count and a qualitative user observation; set a baseline before claiming improvement.

checks.requirement: Important claims resolve to inspectable, dated evidence.
acceptance: Place the source or owned artifact beside each consequential claim.
Distinguish live, prototype, sample, customer-reported and proposed evidence; remove unsupported claims.
evidence: A route-by-route claim ledger with source date, rights, consent and limitations.

checks.requirement: Every consequential action has complete, recoverable states.
acceptance: Exercise loading, empty, error, success, disabled and unavailable states where applicable.
A failed request preserves input and offers a specific recovery; retries do not duplicate a purchase or submission.
Explain credit use, data destination, consent and irreversible consequences before action.
evidence: A journey recording and state matrix covering normal, slow-network, denied-permission and failed-request paths.

checks.requirement: The full task remains usable on a phone and without a pointer.
acceptance: Complete the primary task by keyboard with visible focus, logical order and understandable labels.
Verify 1440px desktop, 390px phone, 320px reflow and 200% zoom with long real content.
Verify contrast, text alternatives and semantic errors; record manual checks as well as automated findings.
evidence: Scoped accessibility report, manual keyboard result and screenshots of each required viewport.

checks.requirement: Use the chosen brand roles with real loaded fonts and readable copy.
acceptance: Use sentence case and real lowercase; preserve proper names, genuine acronyms, code and existing wordmarks.
Use actual licensed weights and styles; inspect fallback, slow loading, long names and clipping in the exported artifact.
Preserve existing owner selections; PR22 recommendations remain proposals until recorded approval.
evidence: Exact font provenance, computed-font report, mobile specimen and export inspection.

checks.requirement: Motion explains an actual state or relationship and keeps control responsive.
acceptance: Name the job of every shipped sequence and retain a complete static journey.
Verify reduced-motion equivalence, interruptibility and intentionally composed phone behavior.
Measure layout stability, loading and input responsiveness on the actual route; decoration cannot delay the primary task.
evidence: Purpose decision, performance report and decoded motion/reduced-motion evidence required by the existing release validator.

checks.requirement: Users can return to, share and use the artifact they created.
acceptance: Exercise save, reopen, share and download when the surface promises them.
Verify exported text, fonts, crops, rights and links in the actual download or native share destination.
Never publish placeholder contact details, stale offer dates or an unapproved identity.
evidence: Reopened artifact and inspected export with source revision, rights, claim date and usage record.

checks.requirement: A structurally valid plan does not constitute a verified experience.
acceptance: Keep maker, independent verifier and named approver separate for public flagship releases.
Use the existing release gate and adoption validator; retain all existing numerical bars and evidence requirements.
Record preview checks before promotion and scoped production verification plus an exact rollback after deployment.
evidence: The existing content-addressed release bundle and independent verdict in the owning product repository.

tool_reviews.scope: Canonical design repository main at c7a58f112b46ddd8ba85844ba03c31a1308bc5eb and open draft typography PR22 at 7cccfcc8c1752eb6e621f99392f096e17ee1ee03.
observations: The existing registry covers 11 brand/domain profiles, 13 owning repositories and 14 surfaces.
PR22 adds typography guidance, font evidence and specimens; it remains a separate open draft.
limitations: Registry coverage is not downstream adoption or production proof.
Domain direction nominations do not constitute identity approval; typography candidates do not replace owner decisions.
tool_reviews.next_action: Validate the shared experience requirements and export a source-pinned brand handoff before changing a product or tool.

tool_reviews.scope: Seven scoped design files and repository links were inspected. One additional file hit the account tool quota; two boards remain unverified.
observations: The inspected FrankX foundation has 60 variables in four one-mode collections, 14 text styles and five effect styles.
No local components were found on the inspected FrankX pages; its overview capture did not form a usable design-system specimen.
The inspected Arcanea master and two GenCreator files contained no owned local system content; vendor references are separate.
limitations: This is a scoped audit, not an account-wide inventory.
The Starter plan tool quota blocked further inspection; Code Connect eligibility requires a separate plan decision.
Counts do not verify token source parity, font bytes, component behavior or library publication.
tool_reviews.next_action: Generate the committed source projection; reconcile identity conflicts; build and verify one desktop and phone flow before publishing its first component family.

tool_reviews.scope: Read-only account inventory and selected design text were audited; most designs were not visually reviewed. Private kit names and tool identifiers remain outside public Git.
observations: The audit returned 337 unique designs, 1454 images, 68 folders, 28 empty folders, six kits and one published Brand Template.
Folder spines existed but several operating folders were empty.
Selected decks and reports contained dated claims or placeholder contact details requiring review before reuse.
limitations: Kit names do not establish their brand relationship, contents, font rights or approval.
Template datasets did not establish a fillable automation workflow; exported visual quality and sync were not verified.
Repeated titles alone do not prove duplicate content.
tool_reviews.next_action: Pilot one approved brand kit and two locked content templates; inspect real exports and register approved media before wider migration.

references.observed: The retrieved homepage names an issue, agent work, a draft PR awaiting review, status changes and review/revert controls.
references.inference: Use real work states to explain capability; make sources and consequences inspectable.

references.observed: The retrieved customer page places named results beside products used and links to deeper customer stories; the source URL redirected to a locale page.
references.inference: Attach specific dated evidence to a consequential claim instead of relying on a logo wall.

references.observed: The retrieved AI page names reusable commands and tasks, model choices, credit usage and local versus enabled cloud storage.
references.inference: Let users start with a concrete task and see input, output, cost and data boundaries.

references.observed: The retrieved course page separates professional roles and topics and includes instructor, duration and start-date information.
references.inference: Route learning by the artifact a person wants to build and disclose actual prerequisites and availability.

references.observed: The retrieved product page names editing tasks, includes before/after labels and connects named use cases to try and learn-more routes.
references.inference: Explain a making task through required input and an owned output example, with recovery and export.

references.observed: The retrieved platform page connects community, courses, events, payments and access; plan descriptions expose included scope and onboarding steps.
references.inference: Keep availability, price, entitlement and the next onboarding step together at the decision point.

flows.recipient: A founder or builder evaluating Frank’s current work.
flows.job: Understand one relevant build and why it matters.
flows.first_useful_outcome: An inspectable field note or working artifact with a dated source.
flows.proof: A real build, authorized source and explicit limitation.
flows.failure_recovery: A missing artifact explains its status and offers another relevant source.

flows.recipient: An AI builder evaluating an architecture approach.
flows.job: Inspect an architecture and decide whether it fits the task.
flows.primary_action: Inspect or run one working example.
flows.first_useful_outcome: A reproducible input, output and trace with its limitations.
flows.proof: Actual source, trace and a named validation result.
flows.failure_recovery: Preserve setup inputs and provide a specific failed-step recovery.

flows.recipient: An operator evaluating governed intelligence and decisions.
flows.job: Understand a decision and inspect its authority.
flows.primary_action: Open the evidence behind one current decision.
flows.first_useful_outcome: A trace from source through transformation and authority to receipt.
flows.proof: An actual provenance record, permission boundary and receipt.
flows.failure_recovery: Explain missing, stale or denied evidence and offer a bounded review path.

flows.recipient: A creator beginning an original world or narrative.
flows.job: Explore an original world and begin a small act of creation.
flows.primary_action: Begin one available creator task and save its artifact.
flows.first_useful_outcome: One saved original artifact with its source and right-use boundary.
flows.proof: Owned world material, a creator output and saved memory.
flows.failure_recovery: Preserve creative input after failure; offer retry, save or an available static path.

flows.recipient: A creator choosing the next useful step in their practice.
flows.job: Choose an available creator step and obtain its artifact.
flows.primary_action: Start one available diagnostic or guided artifact.
flows.first_useful_outcome: A usable brief, installation or creator stack with entitlement explained.
flows.proof: An actual creator artifact and clear availability boundary.
flows.failure_recovery: Preserve inputs and explain unavailable offers without a misleading purchase action.

flows.recipient: A creator seeking a relevant community or cohort.
flows.job: Find a contribution or cohort that matches their current need.
flows.primary_action: Open an available contribution or join a current cohort.
flows.first_useful_outcome: Useful community material or a confirmed place with explicit next steps.
flows.proof: Consented creator output and dated cohort details.
flows.failure_recovery: Provide a useful alternative when a cohort is closed; retain consent choices.

flows.recipient: A practitioner learning AI architecture by building.
flows.job: Choose a relevant lab and understand the next checkpoint.
flows.primary_action: Start a runnable lab with visible prerequisites.
flows.first_useful_outcome: A small working artifact and a verifiable review result.
flows.proof: An actual failing test, hint and pass/fail result.
flows.failure_recovery: Keep checkpoint progress and give a specific hint or setup recovery.

flows.recipient: An operator evaluating a viable commercial system.
flows.job: Evaluate one request-to-quote workflow and its real economics.
flows.primary_action: Inspect one current workflow and its human boundaries.
flows.first_useful_outcome: A scoped operating artifact with dated assumptions and costs.
flows.proof: Actual contracts, costs, approvals and receipts; no implied earnings.
flows.failure_recovery: Explain missing inputs and unavailable offers; permit correction before submission.

flows.recipient: A participant or host beginning a focused work session.
flows.job: Find a suitable session format and understand its controls.
flows.primary_action: Join or start an available session.
flows.first_useful_outcome: A usable session with controls and a consented recap path.
flows.proof: A real timer or mixer state and an authorized session artifact.
flows.failure_recovery: Retain session state after reconnect; label proposed paid features unavailable.

flows.recipient: A reader or creator exploring an original story world.
flows.job: Find a canonical story or character and its release state.
flows.primary_action: Open an owned character or story artifact.
flows.first_useful_outcome: A readable, canonical artifact with provenance and an available next step.
flows.proof: Owned art, a canon source and a clear draft or released label.
flows.failure_recovery: Provide a readable text path when media fails and preserve atlas orientation.

flows.recipient: A builder identifying a missing system in their work.
flows.job: Identify a bounded system need and receive its starter artifact.
flows.primary_action: Complete an available assessment and review the brief.
flows.first_useful_outcome: An exportable brief with assumptions, confidence and an acceptance test.
flows.proof: An actual assessment result and inspectable starter artifact.
flows.failure_recovery: Preserve answers, explain uncertainty and permit correcting the result.

flows.recipient: A creator choosing a compatible tool or equipment system.
flows.job: Choose a system with costs, compatibility and alternatives understood.
flows.primary_action: Inspect one sourced recommendation and its alternatives.
flows.first_useful_outcome: A costed recommendation with source dates and wrong-purchase conditions.
flows.proof: Dated sources, total cost, compatibility and research versus hands-on labels.
flows.failure_recovery: Explain unknown prices or compatibility and offer a human research path.

flows.recipient: A German-speaking buyer describing building and energy needs.
flows.job: Create a reviewable system brief from real building inputs.
flows.primary_action: Complete the intake and review its assumptions before submitting.
flows.first_useful_outcome: A German-language brief with ranges, assumptions and a human review boundary.
flows.proof: Dated assumptions and a scoped human-reviewed proposal path.
flows.failure_recovery: Preserve answers, explain invalid fields in German and allow correction.

flows.recipient: A local buyer evaluating an energy provider and service scope.
flows.job: Understand available local provision and request a scoped quote.
flows.primary_action: Request a human-reviewed quote with clear service boundaries.
flows.first_useful_outcome: A acknowledged request with explicit next steps and consent choices.
flows.proof: Current inventory, authorized installation evidence and service scope.
flows.failure_recovery: Show unavailable stock or service honestly; prevent duplicate submissions.

upgrades.action: Reconcile recorded owner decisions, source packs and surface-specific typography before changing identity tokens.
upgrades.basis: Repository and audit comparison found conflicting sources; newer drafts and app loaders are not automatic identity authority.
exit_criteria: Record the exact owner decision, surface and revision; retain rejected alternatives.
GenCreator preserves its recorded territory; Arcanea distinguishes world, tools and sustained reading; SIS preserves its broader surface modes.
Treat PR22 font recommendations as proposed until their own review is complete.

upgrades.action: Review active offers, dated claims, contact details and rights before reusing exported material.
upgrades.basis: Selected Canva text had stale dates and placeholders; commercial claims elsewhere require surface-specific current sources.
exit_criteria: No placeholder contact, stale availability or unsubstantiated financial result survives publication.
Claims, local prices, service regions, subsidies and affiliate relationships have dated primary evidence.
Existing live pages are audited individually; this task does not establish that every page currently has the sampled defect.

upgrades.action: Generate the source projection, build a desktop and phone architecture flow, then its first reusable component family.
upgrades.basis: The scoped FrankX audit found foundations but no local components or usable overview specimen.
exit_criteria: A committed source revision and mapping identify every imported semantic value.
One actual flow passes loading, empty, error, success, focus and long-copy inspection.
A component and code-prop map are verified against the owning app before library publication.
upgrades.blocker: The account tool quota blocks additional Figma inspection; publishing and Code Connect eligibility need a separate plan decision.

upgrades.action: Use one approved brand to pilot two locked templates: an evidence-led carousel and a current offer or briefing deck.
upgrades.basis: Canva inventory and folder spines do not establish approved, reusable or fillable production templates.
exit_criteria: Resolve kit-to-brand relationships privately without automatic rename.
Lock logo, type roles, colors and required source/date fields; use only approved identity and licensed files.
Inspect a real export at phone size and verify substitutions, cropping, links and factual copy.
Prove fillable fields separately before claiming automation; register approved assets and usage.

upgrades.action: Build an authored first viewport and a bounded architecture journey with real proof.
upgrades.basis: Existing profile gaps include editorial measure, annotation and proof status.
exit_criteria: The homepage opens one relevant dated artifact.
The technical journey exposes input, output, limitations and recovery on desktop and phone.

upgrades.action: Distinguish vision, current capability, provenance and human authority in the registered operations surface.
upgrades.basis: Current profile identifies terminology, memory age, authority and handoff gaps.
exit_criteria: Current capabilities resolve to actual evidence and receipts.
Horizon, Operator, Academy and Cultural modes remain distinct; the registered homepage mode is not silently changed.

upgrades.action: Build one original world-to-artifact journey with stable creator and reading states.
upgrades.basis: Inspected master lacked local content and source families conflict across surface modes.
exit_criteria: One creator input yields a saved artifact with provenance.
Mythic imagery never prevents navigation, sustained reading or reduced-motion completion.

upgrades.action: Give every available creator step one output, entitlement and clear next action.
upgrades.basis: The profile names conflicting entry metaphors; inspected design files lacked local systems.
exit_criteria: Preserve the recorded territory for each named surface.
Product and community journeys expose live availability, real outputs, cohort boundaries and consent.

upgrades.action: Create a lab journey with prerequisites, checkpoints, hints and a verifiable review.
upgrades.basis: Current profile identifies lab and curriculum proof as a differentiating need.
exit_criteria: A fresh learner completes one representative checkpoint.
Setup failure, hint use and review results preserve progress and are understandable.

upgrades.action: Show a bounded operating workflow with dated economics and explicit human approvals.
upgrades.basis: Commercial material requires availability, cost and disclosure evidence before claims.
exit_criteria: A request-to-quote artifact exposes assumptions and real costs.
Proposed offers remain unavailable; affiliates are disclosed and earnings are not implied.

upgrades.action: Make an available session usable with clear controls and a consented recap.
upgrades.basis: Current profile prioritizes session state and a bounded format over generic community marketing.
exit_criteria: Timer, audio controls and reconnect behavior are usable on a phone and keyboard.
Proposed paid features stay unavailable; reduced motion retains the full task.

upgrades.action: Separate canonical story, atlas discovery and creator work while proving media ownership.
upgrades.basis: Current profile requires original world evidence and rejects franchise imitation.
exit_criteria: Canonical and draft artifacts are visibly distinct.
Owned art, crops, text alternatives and source provenance survive the published export.

upgrades.action: Make an assessment produce a complete starter artifact with a bounded next step.
upgrades.basis: Current profile requires method proof rather than framework names alone.
exit_criteria: Users can inspect assumptions, confidence and acceptance criteria.
Answers survive failure and the resulting brief reopens and exports correctly.

upgrades.action: Make recommendations source-dated, compatible, fully costed and honestly qualified.
upgrades.basis: Current buying-guide mode requires provenance and pricing evidence.
exit_criteria: Research-only material is distinguished from hands-on evidence.
Total cost, incompatibilities, alternatives and affiliate disclosures are visible before purchase.

upgrades.action: Resolve the naming hierarchy and make German intake and local quote claims reviewable.
upgrades.basis: Shared brand surfaces need consistent provider, service, inventory and human-review boundaries.
exit_criteria: Brand endorsement and provider relationships have an explicit owner decision.
Dated inventory, ROI or subsidy assumptions are source-backed; intake errors preserve answers.
